biggest_catch: Two tiers with very different effort: the $50 checking tier needs the friend to hold $500+ in recurring direct deposits for 90 days; the $100 mortgage tier requires the friend to close a first mortgage within 90 days of joining.
catches: Friend must not have been a Climb member in the previous year; referral form must be submitted at initial account opening (no retroactive referrals).
Checking tier ($50 to you, $100 to friend): friend joins, opens a checking account, and establishes recurring direct deposit(s) totaling at least $500 posting within 90 days of account opening.
Mortgage tier ($100 each): friend joins and closes a first mortgage within 90 days of account opening.
Cash bonus paid to both members' share accounts once qualifications are met, up to 120 days from account opening.
Both members must be 18+, own at least one share, be current on all credit obligations, and not have caused the CU a loss.
Bonus considered interest and subject to IRS tax reporting; employees ineligible; offer subject to change without notice.

steps: Fill out the Climb referral form to register and get your unique referral code.
Invite friends via social media or email.
Friend registers, joins Climb, and opens a checking account with $500+ in recurring direct deposits within 90 days (or closes a first mortgage within 90 days).
You receive $50 cash ($100 for the mortgage tier) in your share account.
